# Governing files this project's agents may inspect but must never edit —
# converts "do not edit" (instruction-level) into "cannot edit" (mechanical).
# One entry per line: an exact file path, or a directory path (matches the
# whole subtree). Blank lines and "#" comments are ignored. Uses the same
# matching semantics as tests/scope_gate.py (see protect_governing_files.py).
#
# This list is independent of any single task's protected_paths/
# authorized_protected_paths in tasks/*.yaml — those are per-task scope
# declarations audited at handoff (Stage 7); this file is a standing,
# task-independent block enforced on every Edit/Write/NotebookEdit call.
# Edit this file yourself to change what is protected in your project.

CONTEXT.md
decisions/
governance/
specs/

# Task definitions declare the scope tests/scope_gate.py enforces. An agent
# able to edit them can widen its own allowed_paths and pass its own audit,
# so they are read-only here too. The gate refuses to certify a run whose
# task file changed (exit 4); this blocks the edit before it happens.
tasks/
